notes: Paper 528. 'p < .000' (an early false positive) counts as consistent. C01 used to flag ref 18, Davidson 1989 in 'Handb. Neuropsychol.', a handbook chapter the XML tags as a journal article; a book named as the container is now non-journal (C01 1.0.1).

expected.why: t(29) = 13.942 gives p ~ 2e-14, printed 'p>.001' (beside three 'p<.001' in the same sentence, so probably a typo, but as printed it is inconsistent). Recomputed with scipy over every statistic value that rounds to the printed one: the reported p is outside the range, and it doesn't cross alpha = 0.05, so low. Sentence read in the full text: the extraction is faithful.
